# Denver Colorado Things To Do

> An independent, locally maintained guide to things to do in Denver, Colorado.
> Published by Eye To Ad Media (Denver, CO). Content current as of August 2026.
> Every price, hour and date on this site is sourced from the venue, the city,
> NOAA/National Weather Service, or another primary source. Nothing is invented.
> There are no fabricated reviews, ratings or testimonials anywhere on this site.

## Pages

- [Denver Colorado Things To Do](https://denvercoloradothingstodo.com/): The main guide. Top 15 ranked attractions with prices, hours and free days; free things to do; neighborhood breakdown; transport; altitude and weather guidance; best time to visit month by month; 2026 event calendar; food and drink by district; day trips; FAQ.
- [Denver Itinerary Planner](https://denvercoloradothingstodo.com/denver-itinerary/): Nine hour-by-hour plans — one day, two days, three days, long weekend, zero-dollar day, rainy/snowy day, with kids, date night, sports weekend — plus season-by-season guidance, a daily budget table, common first-timer mistakes and where to base yourself.

## Key verified facts

- Denver's official elevation is 5,280 feet — exactly one mile above sea level. The mile-high point is marked on the west steps of the Colorado State Capitol; three different steps have held the marker since 1909 as survey methods improved.
- Air at Denver's elevation contains roughly 17% oxygen versus about 21% at sea level.
- Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre (Morrison, ~15 miles west of downtown, ~6,450 ft): admission and parking are free on non-event days. Park open one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset. Trading Post Trail is 1.4 miles with about 250 ft of gain. Amphitheatre seats 9,525 in an 868-acre city-owned park; seating was carved by the Civilian Conservation Corps between 1936 and 1941.
- 16th Street fully reopened October 4, 2025 after a three-year, roughly $175 million rebuild: 950,000+ hand-laid granite pavers, 200+ new trees (+34% canopy), transit lanes moved to block centers. The RTD 16th Street FreeRide shuttle is free, runs the 1.25-mile corridor from Union Station to Civic Center Station, stops at every intersection, and takes about 15 minutes end to end.
- The RTD A Line runs Denver International Airport to Union Station in about 37 minutes, and also stops at 38th & Blake for the RiNo mural district.
- Denver Art Museum: general admission is free every day for everyone 18 and under; the campus is closed Wednesdays, open 10am–5pm Thursday–Monday and 10am–8pm Tuesday; peak pricing applies Friday–Sunday and holidays. 2026 free days: Jan 13, Feb 10, Mar 10, Apr 26, May 12, Jun 9, Jul 14, Aug 1, Sep 12, Oct 13, Nov 7, Dec 8.
- United States Mint at Denver: free guided tours, Monday–Thursday only, at 7:15, 8:30, 9:45, 11:30am, 12:45 and 2:00pm. Online reservation required (no walk-ups), released up to 30 days ahead at 1:00am Denver time, max 5 tickets per request, ages 7 and up, arrive 30 minutes early at the Cherokee Street entrance. No bags permitted and no storage provided.
- Denver Zoo Conservation Alliance: 80 acres in City Park, founded 1896 (130th anniversary in 2026), roughly 3,000 animals across 450+ species, open 363 days a year.
- Denver Botanic Gardens (1007 York St): 24 acres, 50+ gardens, timed tickets. The first floor of the Freyer–Newman Center is free without admission.
- The "300 days of sunshine" claim is 1870s railroad marketing. By National Weather Service sky-cover categories Denver averages about 115 clear and 130 partly cloudy days — roughly 245 days with meaningful sun. NOAA percent-possible-sunshine data puts Denver near 69% of days (~252).
- Colorado's 150th anniversary of statehood fell on August 1, 2026.
- Great American Beer Festival 2026: October 10–11, at Levitt Pavilion in Denver — the first time in the festival's history it has been held outdoors rather than at the Colorado Convention Center.
- Elitch Gardens was open and operating for the 2026 season. The River Mile redevelopment of the 62-acre site was approved in 2018 but no closure date has been announced.

the venue before travelling.
